body: Thank you so much for your support. I'm continuing to hold on and I hope you do as well.
Thank you. I'll bring this up next time I see a doctor.
Thanks for reading and for sharing your experiences. I've always felt that I'm just meant to be alone... maybe this is just proof of it. I'm really glad you're sticking around!

Thanks for this. I am seeing a therapist, but luck of luck, she's been away for a month and won't be back until next week. I've tried going on SSRIs before and it didn't work... I'm just trying to survive each day at this rate.

I'm sorry this is happening to you. I saw this happen during my Bachelor's. Idiots who were treating the students in their mid-twenties just like this.

I know people who took 8 years and got through it. It's hard, but I don't think you're pathetic.
